notes: four «ح» / new-isnad branches meet at «كل هؤلاء عن الأعمش» and the shared tail follows; «جميعا» makes أبو كريب and إسحاق، بن إبراهيم one level; the variants «زاد عمرو في روايته عن عمار» and «فقالا عن أم مبشر» add a level before the Prophet to some routes, and «وفى رواية ابن فضيل عن امرأة» («امرأة» is an unnamed gap) differ by route; which route carries which extra level is not settled from the text, so none is added and the report needs a ruling; the Prophet is not a link
